newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Communications bid up nearly 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Communications bid up nearly 20 pct.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc's shares were being bid nearly 20 percent higher ahead of the company's market debut on Wednesday.

The company designs and implements marketing programs for its clients. It offered 7.8 million shares in the initial public offering, which were sold at $17 each, above the company's estimated pricing range of $14 to $16.
The shares were indicated at $20 to $22.
